subject: Sponsor match top-up & one-time credit exemption for DemoDay cohort
messages:
From: Sophie Grant <sophie@demoday.org>
To: marissa_cole@redwoodeval.com
Date: 2026-06-14T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Sponsor match top-up & one-time credit exemption for DemoDay cohort

Hi Marissa,

Quick note from DemoDay: our primary sponsor unexpectedly increased their contribution for the July cohort and asked if Redwood would consider a sponsor-match top-up + a one-time exemption to the cohort credit cap so startups can carry unused credits into the next 90 days. This would only apply to the 15 teams in the July DemoDay and is tied to the sponsor logo/PR placement in our materials.

Attached: DemoDay_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW with sponsor changes).

Two asks:
- Can Redwood do a sponsor-match top-up of $12k in credits across the cohort?
- Is there a pathway for a one-time 90-day rollover exemption to the usual 30-day credit expiry for this cohort?

We need to confirm before we finalize the PR blurb and DocuSign. Happy to jump on a 20-min call if easier.

Thanks,
Sophie Grant
Program Director | DemoDay Accelerator
S: (415) 555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodeval.com>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie@demoday.org>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodeval.com, ben_carter@redwoodeval.com
Date: 2026-06-15T09:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor match top-up & one-time credit exemption for DemoDay cohort

Thanks Sophie — appreciate the heads up and congrats on the sponsor bump. Looping in Karthik (sales lead for accelerators) and Ben (finance partner) to scope the ask.

High-level thoughts:
- Sponsor-match: we can probably do a credit top-up, but need to confirm mechanism (hosted account credit vs. promo credits) and the accounting treatment. Ben, can you confirm whether we treat the $12k as a promotional marketing credit or an offset against revenue for this program?
- 90-day rollover exemption: this is unusual relative to our standard 30-day policy. If agreed, we should make it a documented, one-off concession on the SOW with clear usage limits. I attached a snapshot of our current credit policy for quick reference.

If we can align on the approach, I can share a short amendment to the SOW for Sophie to sign (DocuSign link preferred). Sophie — is the sponsor expecting a public logo placement in company marketing and a short quote? If so, we should capture those deliverables in the amendment.

Proposed next steps:
1) Ben to confirm accounting impact and fed-upside risks.
2) Karthik to confirm whether sponsor-match credits should count toward trial conversion metrics (i.e., do we treat them as consumption for converting teams).
3) If approvals are OK, Marissa will prepare a one-paragraph SOW amendment and a DocuSign.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodeval.com | +1 (650) 555-0147

Attachment: credit_policy_snapshot.png

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodeval.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodeval.com>, ben_carter@redwoodeval.com
Date: 2026-06-15T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor match top-up & one-time credit exemption for DemoDay cohort

Marissa / Ben — quick take from Sales ops:

- Sponsor-match top-up of $12k: approve in principle as a one-time promotional credit. Recommend we issue as "promo credits" tied to the DemoDay program (metadata tag: DEMODAY-2026-JUL). This keeps the credits out of core invoiceable balances and simplifies tracking.
- 90-day rollover exemption: I'm OK supporting it if the SOW amendment includes explicit limits (teams only; unused credits expire after 90 days; no refunds). Also recommend a clause that credits do not count toward any referral or discount stacking rules.

Operational asks:
1) Finance (Ben) — confirm tax/accounting treatment for Q2 close. If treated as marketing promo, are we OK from a revenue recognition perspective?
2) Marketing — confirm we get sponsor logo high-res + approved quote by July 1 to include in PR. If sponsor misses that window, we reserve the right to revoke the top-up.

If Ben signs off, I’ll draft the amendment language and a simple acceptance checkbox for the teams so we can track usage. Happy to redline the SOW.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodeval.com>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie@demoday.org>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwoodeval.com, ben_carter@redwoodeval.com
Date: 2026-06-18T09:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sponsor match top-up & one-time credit exemption for DemoDay cohort

Sophie — good news, we can proceed with a conditional, one-time arrangement. Summary below for clarity (final amendment to follow):

What Redwood will provide:
- Sponsor-match promotional credits: $12,000 total, issued as program-tagged promo credits (DEMODAY-2026-JUL) split across the 15 teams per your allocation list.
- One-time 90-day rollover: unused promo credits may be used up to 90 days from issuance; after that they expire. No cash refunds.

Conditions (must be met before top-up is issued):
1) Sponsor provides high-resolution logo and an approved 1–2 sentence quote by 2026-07-01.
2) DemoDay executes the attached SOW amendment via DocuSign (link to follow).
3) Teams must opt in to accept program credits (checkbox in SOW) so we can capture consent for promo terms.

Ben — please confirm accounting/tax stance here but Karthik and I want to treat this as marketing promo credits and get it booked in Q2. If anything looks risky, flag it and we’ll adjust.

Sophie — I’ll send a short amendment draft and a DocuSign today. Nathan (cc), looping you for visibility — happy to take any logistics questions.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodeval.com | +1 (650) 555-0147
